{{Top|leg}}
'''Prosperity Row''' was the legitimate marketplace located in the [[Off-Worlders' Quarter]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ropagi II]]. Standard equipment could be purchased from Prosperity Row, but it did not sell weapons of any kind.
